title: GTM plan: Dedicated Capacity expansion — UK/EU regions, new instance types, reservation tiers
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary: Coordinate cross-functional launch of Redwood Dedicated capacity in two new regions (eu-west-2 and eu-central-1), add two new instance types (rdi.gpu-4 and rdi.gpu-8), and roll out three reservation plans (hourly, monthly commit, annual commit). Goals: ensure smooth capacity availability, accurate pricing and reservation UI, complete release notes and customer communications, and validated SLOs.

Scope:
- Product: pricing matrix, reservation UX, billing contract text
- Infra/Eng: region provisioning, instance validation, autoscale tuning, monitoring
- Console: new UI surfaces for reservation selection, quotas, dashboards
- Docs/Support: release notes, KB articles, migration guides, sales playbook
- GTM: launch email, blog post, sales enablement, marketplace listings

Key deliverables:
- Finalized pricing and reservation tiers
- Reservation purchase flow in Console (end-to-end)
- Updated API for reservation creation and querying
- Release notes draft and internal announcement
- Rollout plan with staged regional enablement
acceptance_criteria: Reservations can be purchased in Console for both new instance types
API returns correct pricing and reservation metadata
Monitoring dashboards show capacity and latency baselines for new regions
Release notes approved by PM, Eng lead, and Legal
Customer-facing KB and migration guide published
checklist: Finalize pricing model and commit discounts (PM + Finance sign-off)
Create release_notes draft and circulate for review
Update Console reservation UI mocks (DES review)
Run capacity soak test in eu-west-2 for 72 hours
Prepare rollback and fallback policies for outage scenarios
Prepare marketing assets: blog, email, doc snippets
Coordinate partner marketplace listings and billing integration
Train support and sales with playbook and FAQ
